data.long_description:
An upmarket gated community brought to you by the Al Habtoor Group, renowned for developing unique destinations in Dubai. This impressive collection of opulent villas is designed with the horse lover in mind. Residents can enjoy all the equine offerings in state of the art facilities or simply watch the world go by from their luxurious private haven.

Property Details:

-Single Row Villa
-4 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
-5 Modern Bathrooms
-3100 Sq ft Built-Up Area
-Plot Size 4162 Sqft
-World Class Polo Field View
-Appliances included
-Thoughtfully Designed Layout
-Andalucian Architecture
-2 Covered Parking Spaces
-Built-In Solar Power System
-Premium Marble Flooring
-Maid’s bedroom

Community Features:

-2 Paddle Courts
-2 Tennis Courts
-2 Swimming Pools & 2 Fully Equipped Gyms
-Dedicated Pilates Studio
-Golf Shooting Range
-Equestrian Stables
-Polo Academy
-Luxury Spa
-Exclusive Beauty Salon
-Football Training Academy
-Archery Academy
-Multiple Licensed Restaurants & Lounges
-Jewelry Boutique & Premium Bentley Store
